 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Identify the non-background patterned rectangle and the zero-filled target rectangle.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg, 0)]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    h, w = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    target = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    tr0, tc0 = min(r for r, c in target), min(c for r, c in target)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            g[tr0+i][tc0+j] = grid[r0+i][c1-j]
    return g
